title: Alexa M5: Certification and publishing (pilot site live in the Alexa Skills Store)
description:
Milestone 5. Pass Amazon's certification and publish the pilot site's skill.

Scope:
- Store listing generated from site config: name, one-sentence and full descriptions, three example phrases that actually work, category (News), keywords, 108px and 512px icons, privacy policy URL and terms URL (clean pages on the site).
- A privacy policy page that covers what the skill receives (the Alexa user ID and the linked account's identity) and what we store.
- Certification testing instructions, plus a dedicated Google test account for Amazon's testers. Ryan creates it, and it gets a reader/editor group on the pilot site. Never a Cognito password user.
- Run the certification checklist ourselves first: the functional test in the developer console, the utterance conflict check, every example phrase, help/stop/cancel, the session-end behaviour, and APL on every viewport.
- Beta test with Ryan's household through the console beta-test feature, then submit, fix whatever the reviewers find, and publish.
- A p.apyr.us docs page for the feature (the document-features rule).

Done when: anyone can find and enable the Pilobolus skill in the Alexa Skills Store, link their account, and use M1 to M4. The docs page is live.
